correctness.rationale: The Rule30 local equation gives exact space-time column transfer T_p(b,c)=(rot(b) xor (b or c),b) on 2^(2p) states. Each spatial cycle of T_p is exactly one p-periodic configuration with primitive spatial length d; if d|n, it represents d distinct indexed ring configurations, which split into d/p0 primitive temporal orbits for least time period p0. Independently compiled and ran a fresh C++ functional-graph census with all 4,096 p6 states and all 16,777,216 p12 states, using indegree peeling then unique directed cycles. At p6 only primitive6 class is spatial length84 multiplicity1; p12 primitive12 classes length60 mult3, length100 mult3 and length138 mult4. Full census also verifies transient/cyclic sums 3,997+99=4,096 and 16,776,057+1,159=16,777,216. 84/6=14, 3*60/12=15, 3*100/12=25, 4*138/12=46. All ring lengths are inferred by exact transfer correspondence, not finite ring-length extrapolation; min lcm=420.
